description:
🎯 Clock in, Sniperintendents. It’s time to get to work!

Take on hundreds of hilarious jobs across six lively locations in Sniper Dan, a delightfully funny, family-friendly 3D Hidden Object game with a big twist.

Decipher clues, scan busy 3D scenes through your sniper scope, find the problem and make things right with one perfectly placed shot. No violence. Just wholesome chaos and good intentions.

And there’s plenty to do when you’re off the clock! Discover Mini-Games, Carnival Games, Time Attack, Ammo Hunt, Photo Mode, secret activities, rifle upgrades, customisation and an incredible amount more throughout Clumsy County.

🔥 Want to go Hotshot? The Hotshot DLC includes 18 gaming-inspired cosmetic items to customise Dan, his rifle and office.

🔍 Spot the problem.
🎯 Take the shot.
🛠️ Make things right.

author: XBOX
description:
Nodding Heads Games reveals developer commentary, focusing on Gameplay and it's unique aspects for  Raji: Kaliyuga. The unsealing of the heavens by the asura warlord Mahabalasura escalates the conflict within the game to a cosmic level. This grand battle encompasses not only mortals but also gods, asuras, and mystical entities.

Raji, now a seasoned warrior, and her dreamwalking brother Darsh, journey to the Eternal Summit to save or destroy the universe. Raji: Kaliyuga features dual protagonists: Raji, with acrobatic martial arts and the Trishul, and Darsh, with immense Siddhi powers that control gravity, time, and energy. It introduces customized evasion for Raji and a siddhi-yielding system for Darsh, allowing unique combat styles. 

The game shifts from an isometric action-adventure to a third-person action-adventure, with Nodding Heads Games committed to delivering a high-quality experience for fans.

Raji: Kaliyuga is coming to XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC as an XBOX Play Anyw
title: Raji: Kaliyuga Gameplay Developer Commentary | XBOX
